profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Paramify
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer with a background in Data Analytics and Machine Learning!

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Engineered comprehensive player dataset by aggregating multiple fragmented football data sources using Python 

Delivered tailored analytical findings to diverse stakeholders in person and through automated weekly reports, ranging from coaches/player personnel to data scientists and faculty, enabling data-informed football decisions
positions.insights: Skills: Pandas (Software) · Presentation Skills · REST APIs · pycaret · Machine Learning · Data Analysis · Strategic Data Analysis

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Developed a web application aimed at preparing students for sales calls with real clients by practicing and refining their sales techniques in a simulated environment, worked closely with stakeholders to understand their requirements and deliver a tool that effectively met their needs

Enabled live, interactive conversations through the seamless integration of multiple OpenAI APIs, collaborated with coworkers to develop the app using a tech stack that included Django (Python) and React.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Conducted sentiment analysis, topic analysis, and summarization on dataset containing 1,500+ survey responses, providing actionable insights for university stakeholders, including the President of the University

Collaborated with small team utilizing stakeholders and experts to drive the analysis and create a 40+ page report

positions.title: Data Support
positions.description:
Preformed extensive data collection and cleaning to construct a database of 10 years of student data, enabling future data analysis and establishing standard data management practices for the organization

Explored the correlation of student success versus background experience to assist in determining ideal 
admissions requirements for the College of Veterinary Medicine

Attended weekly Admissions Development Committee meetings, presented my findings for the week and collaborated with stakeholders in the process of determining ideal admissions requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Data Mining · Data Analytics · Presentation Skills

positions.title: Student Data Analyst
positions.description:
Collaborate with supervisors to develop visually appealing and informative data visualizations using Tableau, effectively presenting insights to university stakeholders and employers

Develop processes to gather and clean data, demonstrating strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality results
